name: DetailLegend
description: DetailLegend - Enhanced chart legend with current values and percentage change indicators

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Callback when a legend item is toggled

fields.name: color
fields.description: Hex color for the default swatch (border, plus 20% opacity fill) and the `color` of a custom `icon`

fields.name: icon
fields.description: Custom icon replacing the default color swatch

fields.name: currentValue
fields.description: Value shown below the label, numbers formatted, with optional `unit`; also the row that holds `percentChange`

fields.name: percentChange
fields.description: Percentage change shown after `currentValue`: positive as a green ▲, negative as a red ▼; hidden when `0`, `null` or wi…
fields.descriptionFull: Percentage change shown after `currentValue`: positive as a green ▲, negative as a red ▼; hidden when `0`, `null` or without `currentValue`

fields.name: hidden
fields.description: Dims the item (30% opacity) to show its dataset is hidden
